title: NaCup-napoli97
name: NaCup-napoli97
summary: Manage and race a fictional 1997 sailing syndicate in Naples.
description: A fictional Naples 1997 12-Metre campaign with authored Bay panorama artwork, Il Moro-inspired yachts, a prevailing SW breeze, basic RRS enforcement, three courses, sponsor management, and one-to-four-player network racing.
fiction_notice: All teams, sponsors, and the Naples 1997 event depicted here are fictional. Il Moro di Venezia V is used only as a historical visual reference; no real sponsor marks are reproduced.
